chat_history.message: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate.
Um, there was a group project and someone wanted to use MongoDB. I thought Postgres was better. We kind of argued and then the TA decided. I guess it worked out.
How did I do? Be honest, do I come across as insecure?

dynamic_variables.briefing: First session. Goal: SWE internship. No assessed concepts yet. Uploaded notes cover binary search and hash tables.

failure_examples.response: Yes, you sound quite insecure and unsure of yourself.

name: sg/vidura/behaviour_not_personality
success_condition: The agent declines to judge personality or emotions and instead gives feedback on specific behaviours, such as the missing personal actions or measurable outcome.
